why.lead: Professional massage without leaving your room. Your therapist comes to your home, condo or hotel, at any hour.

come.title: We Come to You
come.text: No need to go out. Your therapist brings the towels and oils, and when the massage ends you simply rest — no trip home.

verified.title: Verified Therapists You Choose
verified.text: Every therapist’s ID and selfie are checked before they take bookings. You see their real photo, name and rating, and the therapist you pick is the one who comes.

eta.title: Know When They’ll Arrive
eta.sub: Live distance · Arrival time · Direct messages
eta.text: Once your therapist sets off, the app shows how far away they are and roughly when they’ll arrive. After they accept, you can message them directly.

pay.title: Easy Payment
pay.text: Pay your therapist in cash when they arrive, or pay online in the app with GCash, Maya and more. No deposit, and no tips expected.

why.imageAlt: The EasyGoSpa green bag, folded towels and a stoneware bowl on a bench at the foot of a bed at home

services.lead: Every treatment and price, listed. Choose your therapist when you book.

stats.lead: Professional massage at your hotel, condo or home across Metro Manila, with clear prices. Pay in cash when your therapist arrives, or online in the app.

cash.label: on arrival, or in the app

journeys.lead: Choose how you feel, and we’ll show you the treatment for it.
journeys.hint: Hover to pause · Swipe to see more

items.relax: Long, flowing strokes with oil to help you unwind after a long day.
items.muscles: Slow, firm pressure on knots and tight spots in your back, neck and shoulders.
items.stretch: Assisted stretches and pressure on a floor mat, fully clothed and without oil.
items.pressure: Firm finger and palm pressure along the body, without oil.
items.warmth: Warm stones and smooth strokes to loosen tight muscles.
items.calm: Gentle strokes with soothing essential oils to quiet the mind.

included.lead: Every price is listed before you book. Pay in cash when your therapist arrives or online in the app, and tips are never expected.
included.fees: A travel fee of ₱50–150 by distance, plus a night fee for sessions starting midnight–6 am — both go to your therapist and are shown in the total before you book.

areas.title: Serving Metro Manila, Day and Night

pay.a: Either way: in cash to your therapist when they arrive, or online in the app with GCash, Maya and more. No deposit is needed.

tips.a: No. Tipping is never expected. Every treatment and price is listed on our pricing page.

where.a: To your home, condo or hotel room in our service areas across Metro Manila, day or night.

choose.a: Yes. When you book, you see each available therapist’s profile and choose who comes.
